title: Prime X Hub UN invis Aimbot DANGER Detection UPDATE
features:
PRIME Hub - Features Summary
🎮 Game Features
1. ESP (Enemy Visualization)

Real-time box ESP around all players
Shows player locations through walls
Toggle ON/OFF
Color-coded visibility

2. Aimbot (Zone-Restricted)

Auto-aims at closest enemy
Zone Limited: Only targets players in cuboid area (X: -29 to 29, Y: -4 to 0, Z: -39 to 19)
FOV circle visualization
Adjustable FOV size (50-500 radius)
Slider control for FOV
Toggle ON/OFF

3. Auto Trophy

Automatically collects trophies
Triple-touch system for reliability
Anti-glitch protection
Works on respawn
Toggle ON/OFF

4. Safe Location

One-click teleport to safe zone
External script loader
Quick escape feature


🛡️ Laser Defense System
1. Laser Detection

Detects all player lasers in 50 stud range
Shows laser beams visually (Neon effect)
Anti-clockwise vertical rotation (90° down from right arm)
Real-time threat tracking

2. Visual Alerts

Status Display: SAFE (green) / DANGER (red)
Flashing warning when under threat
Shows aiming player name + distance
Tracks closest threat

3. Laser Customization

Adjustable laser width (2-5 studs)
Color-coded: Green (safe) / Red (dangerous)
"Show All" or "Danger Only" mode
Increase/Decrease/Reset buttons

4. Auto Safe Zone

Auto-teleport when lasers aim at you
Finds safe position away from threats
Toggle ON/OFF
Visual feedback on teleport

5. Real-time Info

Players aiming at you count
Closest threat distance
Total players in range
Live accuracy metrics
